case: exposes live preview state and renders draft field values when Live Preview signals a draft entry
why: The test asserts that when Live Preview is active (isLivePreviewEnabled=true, livePreviewHash=1), getContentByKey returns draft-specific field values like "Draft title", "Draft heading", and "Draft body copy", which would fail if draft values were not rendered.
vc: When the Live Preview SDK signals a draft entry, the page renders the draft field values — such as updated text, headings, and images — corresponding to the unpublished state of that entry.

why: The test only verifies three text fields via a hook's getContentByKey method and does not exercise images, layout, or actual page rendering for visible errors, so violations of the requirement involving those content types would not cause any test to fail.
vc: When the Live Preview feature is not active, the page renders all published content — headings, text blocks, images, and layout — completely and without visible errors.

case: updates the consumer with new draft content when the live preview hash changes, without a page reload
why: The test simulates a Live Preview SDK signal by changing the context's livePreviewHash and draft content, then calls rerender() (not a full reload/remount) and asserts the consumer sees the updated draft field values.
vc: When the Live Preview SDK signals a change to a draft entry, the page updates to show the new draft content without a full browser page reload.

why: The tests only assert on hook return values via renderHook and never mount a page component or inspect rendered DOM output for layout completeness, broken elements, or missing sections.
vc: When the preview environment is configured and Live Preview is active, the page renders all content and layout without visible rendering errors, broken elements, or missing sections.

why: The tests mock the Contentstack context directly rather than setting preview environment variables, and they test a hook in isolation rather than verifying that the page loads successfully when those variables are configured.
vc: When the documented preview environment variables are set to valid values, the page loads successfully and displays draft content for entries with unpublished changes.

why: No test introduces authentication or asserts that draft content is withheld when the Live Preview SDK signals a draft update on a page requiring authentication.
vc: For pages that require authentication, draft content preview may not render even when the Live Preview SDK signals a draft entry update.
